[element-table-wrap-group]
=== `<table-wrap-group>` Table Wrapper Group

Container element for tables (<<element-table-wrap,`<table-wrap>`>> elements) that are to be displayed together.

#### Usage/Remarks
The <<attribute-position,`@position`>> attribute may be used to indicate whether a <<element-table-wrap-group,`<table-wrap-group>`>> must be anchored at its exact location within the text or whether it may float, for example, to the top of the next page, into the next column, to the end of a logical file, or within a separate window.

#### Attributes

* <<attribute-content-type,`@content-type`>>
* <<attribute-orientation,`@orientation`>> (default = portrait)
* <<attribute-originator,`@originator`>>
* <<attribute-position,`@position`>> (default = float)
* <<attribute-specific-use,`@specific-use`>>
#### Base Attributes

* <<attribute-id,`@id`>>
* <<attribute-xml-base,`@xml:base`>>
* <<attribute-xml-lang,`@xml:lang`>>
